'''Redbrand's Digsite''' is an excavation area located in the southern [[Badlands]]. It was established by members of the [[Redbrand Estate]], a prestigious family of [[Dwarf|dwarves]] of [[Ironforge]], in order to look into the ancient heritage of the dwarves - and earn some money. However, it has been overrun by [[trogg]]s, and much of the family that was here was killed.
